div.head: VI As 9
div.ab: Nígoðe: Þæt we cwædon be þisum þeofum þe man on hrǽdinge fule geaxian ne mæg ⁊ man eft geaxað, þæt he fúl bið ⁊ scildig; þæt se hlaford hine oððe þa magas on þæt ilce gerád útniman, þe man þa menn útnimð, þe æt ordale fule weorðað.

With respect to those thieves who cannot be proved guilty on the spot, but who are subsequently convicted and proved guilty: we have declared, that such a one may be liberated from prison by his lord or his relatives, on the same terms as apply to the liberation of men who have been proved guilty at the ordeal.

Nonum: Diximus de illis latronibus, qui in hredinge noxii nequeunt (nequeunt culpabiles) inueniri: et postmodum inquiritur, quod inmundus sit et reus (rei sint et immundi), ut dominus uel parentes eius eodem modo educant eum (eorum sic educant eos), quomodo educitur qui in ordalio est reus inuentus (contaminatus inuenitur).
